about_the_game:
Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.

Inspired by the classic pinball Space Cadet we loved during our childhood, Appulse is a reinterpretation of the genre. Bringing newcomers and old timers by mixing the juicy mechanics of the pinball, and the thrilling and fast gameplay of a roguelite shooter, we want to spark a new interest among the gamer community!

We stayed faithful to the pinball legacy and designed a completely unique table for Appulse. In this game you are entirely immersed into a space war. Your goal is to protect the capital
ship while he is cruising through space to escape the grasp of the robot syndicate.

Attack is the best form of defence!
Jump on enemies spaceships using your cannon. Challenges and special events await you in these unknown territories. Conquer ships to add them to your fleet and win the war.

Do not worry, you are bringing your own arsenal to face the trouble!
Pick the weapon of your choice to destroy the tripods trying to destroy your ship. The twist to the way you play a regular pinball, is that you will be able to control your ball thanks to recoil when firing. Master this technique and you will be capable to go anywhere you want!
 

Guns are not the only cards in your sleeve. Along the way you will power up your character thanks to special perks. Need more recoil when firing? Turrets to assist you in the ship's defense ? Or maybe the ability to slow down time to do the perfect action? You have the cards in your hands to create the perfect build!
But be aware, they are all randomized, so you are guaranteed to have a unique run each time you put a coin in the machine.


Use your flipper with precision, craft your own build, defeat your foes and master the scoreboard!
